text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haa... Haa!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haa... Haa! Ha... Haa...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haa... ¡Gané!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ¡Todas! ¡Gané!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan A
text_block_list.text: ¡E-eso dio miedo!

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan A
text_block_list.text:
¿Viste sus ojos? ¡Parecía una maniática! ¿Qué le
pasó a nuestro Ángel de Nieve?!

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan B
text_block_list.text: Es linda, pero ¿por qué su forma de correr no lo es? No me inscribí para esto...

text_block_list.name: Bandwagon Fan B
text_block_list.text: Creo que ya tuve suficiente de competencias...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ¡Huuuuh?! ¿Q-qué está pasando?!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text: ¡Buen trabajo, Harp Alpha!

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan B
text_block_list.text:
¡Fue una gran competencia! Sé que tienes más en
ti. ¡Las carreras de otoño serán increíbles!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(Pensé que al vencerla las cosas cambiarían. Por
eso me esforcé tanto...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Was I wrong?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: What makes me and her so diff'rent?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin has managed to defeat a tough
opponent, but when she returns to the waiting
room, there's nothing but confusion on her face.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks oodles!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You're right! I won, sure as eggs are eggs!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But it sure doesn't feel like it, the way ev'ryone
outside's act'n.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I wasn't cool enough t'win over the crowd
like I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, maybe it'll change when I win the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Shuka Sho is the final race of the Triple
Tiara. If Yukino Bijin is able to win it, all
doubts about her skill will be washed away.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If I nab a killer vict'ry there, maybe the people
bummed out today'll start lik'n me again.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Don't y'think?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
How about a word for your fans watching at home?
In that cute accent of yours, if you don't mind!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Bridging the gap between what she wants and what
the spectators want will be no simple task. But
she's trying to remain optimistic.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um! Can I ask a favor?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanna do a race b'fore the Shuka Sho t'make sure
I turn heads.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I think it'll help me hold on to this strong
desire t'win...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Any idea which one I should do?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Senior-year runners can also enter the Queen
Stakes, which makes it a good place to test her
strength and solidify her confidence before the
Shuka Sho.
choice_data_list:
Es en pleno campamento de verano, habrá que
moverse, pero...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's perfectly peachy t'me! I'm used to long
trips!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Okey dokey! I'm gonna kick that race right in the
heinie!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decide on the Queen Stakes as our
warm-up for the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
"And the winner of this year's Japanese Oaks is
Yukino Bijin! Regional sensation Yukino Bijin has
run away with the win!"

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Wow. You're incredible, Yuki...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen you look so fierce b'fore...
You're so cool I can barely stand it...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I gotta keep work'n hard if I wanna make my dream
come true too!
